items.title: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
items.summary: The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

items.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
items.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil’s largest crypto exchange, hit by $46 million security breach
items.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin confirmed earlier Monday a security incident and paused withdrawals.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
items.summary: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.
